title: Three branches to one in zap-extensions
description: How zap-extensions went from alpha, beta, and master branches to a single main line, and a change in commit SHAs that predates it. Based on the repository and GitHub's pull request records.

chapters.title: Pull requests into three branches
chapters.text: GitHub's records show pull requests targeting three branches from mid-2015: #6 into beta (2015-06-02), #7 into master (2015-06-15) and #9 into alpha (2015-07-06). Merge commits such as "Merge origin/alpha into alpha" and "Merge branch 'beta' ... into beta" (July and August 2015) are part of the history today.

chapters.title: Commits before 23 March 2016 have different SHAs
chapters.text: The record for pull request #100 names merge commit 3e23916b... and GitHub reports that commit no longer exists. The repository holds a commit with the same subject and date, dac331b1, but a different SHA. Every pull request checked up to #292 (merged 2016-03-22) names a merge commit that is absent from the repository; every one from #293 (2016-03-23) onward is present. This is consistent with history before that date having been rewritten. The data does not say why.

chapters.title: The last pull requests into alpha and beta
chapters.text: On 2019-04-03 the last pull requests merged into beta (#1973) and alpha (#1974) are both titled "Build add-ons with Gradle". The same morning the commit "Remove Ant build and set up Gradle build" lands. Status moves from the branch an add-on lived on to a per-add-on setting in its Gradle build.

chapters.title: master continues, then main
chapters.text: Pull requests into master continue until #2979, merged 2021-06-11. The default branch today is main.
